notes: Original title and DOI verified in supplied primary text. PDF pages 5–6 (printed pp. 434–435) rendered and inspected. The supplied description names the paper and Experiment 2, and p. 5 (printed p. 434) reports several distinct tests. It does not specify numerical versus physical task, RT versus error rate, value interference versus distance effect, or main versus control analysis. No unique target test can be assigned. Printed candidates on p. 434: numerical same–different distance effect RT F(1, 28) = 26.69, p < .001; ER F(1, 28) = 8.69, p < .01; ER distance-by-notation interaction F(2, 56) = 4.09, p < .05; numerical task exposure-duration RT F(1, 28) = 5.95, p < .05; physical same–different value interference RT F(1, 28) = 13.08, p < .005; ER F(2, 56) = 33.40, p < .001; filler-digits value interference RT F(1, 28) = 12.23, p < .005. Printed p. 435: physical-task-first value interference RT F(1, 14) = 5.66, p < .05; ER F(1, 14) = 16.66, p < .001; physical-task CDE analysis exposure-duration RT F(1, 28) = 14.03, p < .001; task-order RT F(1, 28) = 5.05, p < .05; no significant CDE and no significant effects in ER, without a numerical test for these nonsignificant effects. These are candidate statistics, not extracted row values. The printed study participant total 32 is a candidate model N only; the physical-task-first control uses a subset whose N is not explicitly printed here. No N inferred from df, no group N sum or metric conversion performed. Replication and reported success are unassigned placeholders.
